editor_note: None of the 35 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The numbers are all kept (1024/1000 shots, 900 randomizations, 10 parameter sets, three unique instructions, result 0/1), the equality conditions in [40] survive ("단일 qubit 게이트를 제외하면", other annotations ignored), and rendering "expected value" in [52] as "이상적인 값" avoids a clash with 기댓값. Three spots are stiff: [5] "요구 사항을 사용해서 개발되었어요" is a calque, [14] ends in a clipped note-style parenthetical "(… circuit이라고 함)", and [38] "함수를 편의상 사용할 수 있어요" reads as translationese. [5] also slips into honorific "사용하시길", where plain 해요체 fits better.

examples.source: The code on this page was developed using the following requirements.
examples.translation: 이 페이지의 코드는 다음 요구 사항을 사용해서 개발되었어요.
examples.suggested: 이 페이지의 코드는 다음 요구 사항에 맞춰 개발되었어요. 이 버전 이상을 사용하는 것을 권장해요.
examples.why: '요구 사항을 사용해서' is a literal calque of 'using the requirements'. '사용하시길' is an honorific slip away from plain 해요체.

examples.source: (referred to as an instruction set architecture (ISA) circuit)
examples.translation: (명령어 집합 아키텍처 (ISA) circuit이라고 함)
examples.suggested: … 트랜스파일해요. 이런 circuit을 명령어 집합 아키텍처(ISA) circuit이라고 해요.
examples.why: A clipped note-style '~이라고 함' inside running 해요체 prose is stiff, and the nested parentheses make it harder to read.

examples.source: You can do this manually or use the `generate_boxing_pass_manager` function from Samplomatic for convenience.
examples.translation: 이것은 수동으로 하거나 Samplomatic의 `generate_boxing_pass_manager` 함수를 편의상 사용할 수 있어요.
examples.suggested: 직접 할 수도 있고, 간편하게 Samplomatic의 `generate_boxing_pass_manager` 함수를 사용할 수도 있어요.
examples.why: '이것은 … 편의상 사용할 수 있어요' follows English word order. A native writer would use the '~할 수도 있고 ~할 수도 있어요' construction.

editor_note: All six rewritten entries keep the meaning of the English. The shapes (10, 1024, 3), (28, 10, 1024, 3) and (28, 10, 1, 3), the "(among others)" caveat (다른 키들과 함께) and the one-shot bit-flip reason all survive. The problem is register, which is mixed across the rewrites and inside one of them. Entries 7 and 33 are in 합니다체 (일부입니다, 포함됩니다), entries 21 and 30 are in 해요체, and entry 27 opens with "…QuantumProgramResult입니다." and then switches to 포함해요/없어요. In entry 27, "Sampler 출력을 다룰 때처럼 … 기억해 둘 필요가 더 이상 없어요" can briefly read as "just as with Sampler, you don't need to memorize"; "Sampler 출력에서와 달리" would make the contrast clear.

examples.source: Executor's output is a QuantumProgramResult, which is an iterable. It contains one entry per input QuantumProgramItem...
examples.translation: Executor의 출력은 반복 가능한 [`QuantumProgramResult`](...)입니다. 입력 항목과 같은 순서로 입력 `QuantumProgramItem`당 하나의 항목을 포함해요.
examples.suggested: Executor의 출력은 반복 가능한 [`QuantumProgramResult`](...)예요. 입력 항목과 같은 순서로 입력 `QuantumProgramItem`당 하나의 항목을 포함해요.
examples.why: This entry switches from 합니다체 to 해요체 between its first two sentences. The mix also runs across the rewrites: entries 7 and 33 are fully 합니다체, while entries 21 and 30 are 해요체.

examples.source: so you no longer need to memorize these names like you did with Sampler output
examples.translation: Sampler 출력을 다룰 때처럼 이 이름들을 따로 기억해 둘 필요가 더 이상 없어요
examples.suggested: Sampler 출력에서와 달리 이 이름들을 따로 기억해 둘 필요가 없어요
examples.why: Here '~처럼' can attach to '필요가 없어요' and read as 'as with Sampler, no need to memorize'. '더 이상' saves the meaning, but '와 달리' states the contrast directly.

examples.source: This item contains multiple keys.
examples.translation: 이 항목에는 여러 키가 포함됩니다.
examples.suggested: 이 항목에는 여러 키가 포함돼요.
examples.why: The whole entry is in 합니다체, while the parallel CircuitItem entry (30), rewritten at the same time, is in 해요체. That breaks the register within the Outputs section.

editor_note: None of the four rewritten entries (7, 26, 36, 37) changes the meaning. The numbers (14e,12o), (C[2s,2p], O[2s,2p], H[1s]), cc-pvdz, 폐각 Hartree Fock, "two or three iterations" and "three iterations of S-CORE" all match the English. Two small fixes are still worth making. In entry 7, "the electronic structure of which" is copied into Korean as a dangling "그 전자 구조는" placed right after "템플릿", so it reads as the template's electronic structure instead of methanol's. In entry 26, "Importantly" becomes "특히" ("in particular"), which weakens the emphasis, and entry 12 already renders the same word as "중요한 것은".

examples.source: This guide utilizes the template with a methanol molecule as the solute, the electronic structure of which is simulated explicitly, and water as the solvent, approximated as a continuous dielectric medium.
examples.translation: 이 가이드는 용질로 메탄올 분자를 사용하는 템플릿을 활용하며, 그 전자 구조는 명시적으로 시뮬레이션되고, 용매로는 물을 사용하여 연속 유전 매질로 근사합니다.
examples.suggested: 이 가이드에서는 전자 구조를 명시적으로 시뮬레이션하는 메탄올 분자를 용질로, 연속 유전 매질로 근사하는 물을 용매로 하여 템플릿을 사용합니다.
examples.why: This copies the English relative clause word for word. Because "그 전자 구조" comes right after "템플릿", it grammatically points back to the template instead of methanol, and the sentence reads stiffly.

examples.source: Importantly, the user has to determine the `number_of_shots`...
examples.translation: 특히 사용자는 LUCJ Circuit의 측정 횟수에 해당하는 `number_of_shots`를 반드시 정해야 합니다.
examples.suggested: 중요한 점은, 사용자가 LUCJ 회로의 측정 횟수에 해당하는 `number_of_shots`를 정해야 한다는 것입니다.
examples.why: "특히" means "in particular" and does not carry the emphasis of "Importantly". Entry 12 renders the same word as "중요한 것은", so the file is inconsistent.

editor_note: None of the seven rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The conditions are intact: statevector covers *ideal* circuits, density_matrix covers *noisy* ones, stabilizer requires all errors to be Clifford, and unitary does not support measurement, reset or noise. The rewrites switch register from item to item. Entries 8 and 20 use 해요체 (지원하지 않아요, 시뮬레이션이에요), but entries 15-18 and 34 use 합니다/입니다, so entry 20 is the only 해요체 item in the list of simulation methods (14-22). Entry 18 also adds a gloss that is not in the English, "(안정자 상태들의 중첩)", and changes the source's "ranked-stabilizer" to "rank-stabilizer".

examples.source: "unitary": A dense unitary matrix simulation of an ideal circuit. ... it does not support measurement, reset, or noise.
examples.translation: 이상적인 Circuit의 밀집 유니터리 행렬 시뮬레이션이에요. ... 측정, 리셋 또는 노이즈를 지원하지 않아요.
examples.suggested: Use one register across all of list items 14-22. Either convert every sibling item to 해요체 (house style) or keep this item in the same 입니다 form as its neighbours.
examples.why: This is the only 해요체 item in a list where every sibling (15-19, 21, 22) ends in 입니다/합니다, so the list reads unevenly.

examples.source: based on decomposing the state into a ranked-stabilizer state
examples.translation: 상태를 rank-stabilizer 상태(안정자 상태들의 중첩)로 분해하는 방식에 기반한
examples.suggested: 상태를 ranked-stabilizer 상태로 분해하는 방식에 기반한
examples.why: The parenthetical gloss is not in the source, and the term is changed from ranked- to rank-stabilizer. The gloss is roughly accurate, so this is not misleading, but it is added content.

examples.source: The Executor primitive does not support local testing mode.
examples.translation: Executor 기본 요소는 로컬 테스트 모드를 지원하지 않아요.
examples.suggested: Keep 해요체 as house style, but align the rest of the page (currently 합니다) so the register is consistent.
examples.why: This note is in 해요체 while the surrounding prose (7, 9, 10, 11, 23) is in 합니다체. The switch comes from the partial rewrite.

editor_note: All three rewritten entries say the same thing as the English. Entry 4 keeps "only when you use both packages → no action needed" and the Aer 0.13 version point. Entry 9 correctly renders "more than two qubits" as "세 개 이상의 Qubit" and keeps both caveats about what the coupling map leaves out. The one thing a native editor would change is in entry 7: "Qiskit이 Circuit을 실행을 위해 최적화하는" stacks two object markers (을…을) and reads stiffly. "실행에 맞게 Circuit을 최적화하는" would read better. The new entries use 합니다 endings, which matches the rest of this page, so I did not flag register.

examples.source: the transpilation constraints that Qiskit can use to optimize circuits for execution
examples.translation: Qiskit이 Circuit을 실행을 위해 최적화하는 데 사용할 수 있는 트랜스파일 제약 조건
examples.suggested: Qiskit이 실행에 맞게 Circuit을 최적화하는 데 사용할 수 있는 트랜스파일 제약 조건
examples.why: The two stacked object markers ('Circuit을 실행을 위해') are a calque of 'optimize circuits for execution' and read awkwardly. Reordering it with '실행에 맞게' reads naturally and keeps the meaning.

editor_note: I checked all 23 rewritten entries against the English and none of them would mislead a learner. The QHE/QHE Hard description in [10]-[11] is accurate, including the ~150 tests, the 기초/중급/고급 difficulty levels and the removed import information. The Jupyter AI v2.x pin in [100] and the rule about Ollama not appearing without langchain-ollama are also correct. What's left is stiffness a Korean editor would fix: [72] uses a stiff 이는 and ends with a misattached modifier ('로컬 GGUF 모델 파일을 가리키는 명령줄에서 실행돼요'), [100] says the same thing twice ('확실히 얻도록 보장해요'), and [82] puts the recommendation first and ends with a dangling '…의 시스템 프롬프트예요'.

examples.source: It provides low-level control over the model execution and is typically run from the command line, pointing to a local GGUF model file.
examples.translation: 이는 모델 실행에 대한 저수준 제어를 제공하며 일반적으로 로컬 GGUF 모델 파일을 가리키는 명령줄에서 실행돼요.
examples.suggested: 모델 실행을 저수준에서 제어할 수 있고, 보통 명령줄에서 로컬 GGUF 모델 파일 경로를 지정해 실행해요.
examples.why: The Korean attaches 'pointing to a local GGUF model file' to the command line itself, which reads oddly. The stiff 이는 is also a calque of the English 'It'.

examples.source: The "jupyter-ai<3" pin ensures you get v2.x.
examples.translation: `"jupyter-ai<3"` 고정은 v2.x를 확실히 얻도록 보장해요.
examples.suggested: `"jupyter-ai<3"`로 버전을 고정하면 v2.x가 설치돼요.
examples.why: '확실히 얻도록 보장해요' says the same thing twice and sounds like translated English. The noun phrase '고정은' as the subject is also stiff.

examples.source: we recommend using the system prompt provided in our HF GGUF repositories: system prompt for [...], [...], [...], and [...].
examples.translation: …시스템 프롬프트를 사용하는 것이 좋아요: [...], [...], [...], [...]의 시스템 프롬프트예요.
examples.suggested: …HF GGUF 저장소에서 제공하는 시스템 프롬프트를 사용하는 것이 좋아요. 각 모델의 시스템 프롬프트: [...], [...], [...], [...]
examples.why: The added copula '…의 시스템 프롬프트예요' after the colon list is awkward. It keeps the English sentence structure where Korean would use a simple list label.

editor_note: Of the 5 rewritten entries, 67, 111 and 160 are accurate and read naturally. 그람-슈미트 과정 is used consistently, and the empty-sum caveat for Π=0 is kept in full. Entry 94 drops the hedge "typically", so '직교 사영이라는 용어를 사용합니다' reads as a fixed convention rather than a common one. Entry 97 opens with the dangling fragment '임의의 단위 벡터 $\vert\psi\rangle$에 대해.', which repeats a condition already moved into entry 95's sentence. Neither problem would mislead a learner.

examples.source: when this is done the term *orthogonal projection* is typically used to refer to matrices satisfying both properties.
examples.translation: 이 경우 두 조건을 모두 만족하는 행렬을 가리키기 위해 *직교 사영(orthogonal projection)*이라는 용어를 사용합니다.
examples.suggested: 이 경우 두 조건을 모두 만족하는 행렬은 보통 *직교 사영(orthogonal projection)*이라고 부릅니다.
examples.why: The qualifier 'typically' was dropped, so a usual convention now reads as a fixed rule.

examples.source: for any unit vector $\vert \psi\rangle$.
examples.translation: 임의의 단위 벡터 $\vert \psi\rangle$에 대해.
examples.suggested: (Drop this line, since entry 95 already says '임의의 단위 벡터 $\vert \psi\rangle$에 대해'.) 이 행렬이 에르미트 행렬임은 다음과 같이 확인할 수 있습니다.
examples.why: This verbless fragment copies English word order, and entry 95 already states the same condition, so the Korean says it twice.

editor_note: None of the 37 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The figures (400 minutes, 30-120 minutes, depth around 30, 120 qubits, ~30%, ~10x) and the negations (entries 26, 42, 74) match the English. There are a few small meaning slips. In entry 16, "(if not a focus)" became "(초점이 없더라도)", which drops the hint that many grants actually make this a focus. In entry 47, "some circuits can certainly go beyond that" was softened to "넘어설 수도 있어요". In entry 34, "pushing the limits" became "한계를 뛰어넘는", which says the limits are exceeded rather than pushed. Several phrases are calqued and read stiffly: "잘 정보된 내러티브" and "매칭을 허용하기 위해" (82), "성공적인 보조금 작성 역사" (26), "어워드 검색 검색" (66). In entry 26, "principal investigators" came out as "주요 연구자" rather than the usual 연구 책임자(PI).

examples.source: many grants will at least have a requirement (if not a focus) on education and workforce development
examples.translation: 많은 보조금이 교육과 인력 개발에 대한 요구 사항을 갖고 있을 거예요(초점이 없더라도).
examples.suggested: 많은 보조금이 교육과 인력 개발을 핵심 초점으로 삼지는 않더라도 최소한 요구 사항으로는 포함하고 있을 거예요.
examples.why: 'if not a focus' means it may well be a focus. '초점이 없더라도' makes it sound as if these grants lack that focus, which flattens the claim.

examples.source: some circuits can certainly go beyond that
examples.translation: 일부 Circuit은 그것을 넘어설 수도 있어요
examples.suggested: 일부 회로는 분명히 그보다 더 깊이 갈 수 있어요
examples.why: 'certainly' was softened to a hedge (-ㄹ 수도), which weakens the source's claim.

examples.source: crafting a well-informed narrative ... to allow matching to funding agency norms
examples.translation: 잘 정보된 내러티브를 작성하는 데 ... 자금 기관 규범에 맞는 매칭을 허용하기 위해
examples.suggested: 근거가 탄탄한 내러티브를 작성하는 데 ... 자금 기관의 관행에 맞춰 찾아볼 수 있도록
examples.why: '잘 정보된' and '매칭을 허용하기 위해' are literal calques that no Korean technical writer would use.

examples.source: open to principal investigators at universities and national labs ... demonstrating a history of successful grant writing
examples.translation: 대학과 국립 연구소의 주요 연구자에게 열려 있어요 ... 성공적인 보조금 작성 역사를 보여주는
examples.suggested: 연구 책임자(PI)에게 열려 있어요 ... 보조금 수주 실적을 보여주는
examples.why: 'principal investigator' is conventionally 연구 책임자(PI). '작성 역사' is a calque; 실적 is the natural word here.

examples.source: Search [NSF awards search] for public abstracts
examples.translation: 공개 요약에 대한 [NSF 어워드 검색] 검색
examples.suggested: [NSF 수상 과제 검색]에서 공개 초록을 찾아보세요
examples.why: The doubled '검색 검색' and the noun-stack phrasing read as raw machine translation.

editor_note: None of the 8 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The even/odd parity logic in [37], [48] and [49], the degenerate-code caveat in [41] and the break-even claim in [67] all match the English. Three small edits remain. [29] opens with the humble 말씀드리자면, which breaks the house register. [52] turns "such a loop of X errors" into 이러한 오류 체인, even though the page contrasts chains that have endpoints with closed loops. [64] adds the parenthetical (세 개 이상인), which the English does not have.

examples.source: To be clear about this, we do in fact care equally about all of the stabilizer generators
examples.translation: 명확히 말씀드리자면, 우리는 실제로 모든 안정화기 생성원을 동등하게 중요시하며
examples.suggested: 분명히 해 두자면, 우리는 실제로 모든 안정화기 생성원을 동등하게 중요시하며
examples.why: 말씀드리다 is a humble/honorific form (드리). The house register forbids it, and no other sentence on the page uses it.

examples.source: Such a loop of $X$ errors is not contained in the stabilizer
examples.translation: 이러한 오류 체인은 안정화기에 포함되지 않습니다.
examples.suggested: 이러한 $X$ 오류 루프는 안정화기에 포함되지 않습니다.
examples.why: This section contrasts chains that have endpoints (detected) with closed loops (undetected). Calling the loop a 체인 blurs that contrast, and the translation also drops the $X$ qualifier.

examples.source: a syndrome with more than two $-1$ entries is measured
examples.translation: $-1$ 항목이 두 개보다 많은(세 개 이상인) 증후군이 측정되는 경우입니다.
examples.suggested: $-1$ 항목이 두 개보다 많은 증후군이 측정되는 경우입니다.
examples.why: The parenthetical (세 개 이상인) is not in the source and repeats what 두 개보다 많은 already says. It also hints that three -1 entries can occur, but on the torus the number of -1 entries is always even.

editor_note: None of the 11 rewritten entries misleads. The cost analysis in [140]/[141] (O(n^2) per controlled-unitary, O(n^3) total), the caveats in [87]/[148] and the split-N algorithm in [149] all match the English. Two small things a native editor would still change. [140] opens two clauses in a row with 따라서 ("따라서 … 지배합니다 — 따라서 총 비용은"), which reads stiffly. [149] step 4 renders "the order of a modulo N" as "N에 대한 a의 위수". The page defines the term at [30] as "N을 법으로 한 a의 위수", so the step should use the same wording.

examples.source: Thus, the cost of the controlled-unitary operations dominates the cost of the entire procedure — which is therefore $O(n^3)$.
examples.translation: 따라서 제어 유니타리 연산의 비용이 전체 절차의 비용을 지배합니다 — 따라서 총 비용은 $O(n^3)$입니다.
examples.suggested: 따라서 전체 절차의 비용은 제어 유니타리 연산의 비용이 지배하며, 총 비용은 $O(n^3)$입니다.
examples.why: Two clauses in a row start with 따라서, which is a calque of 'Thus … therefore' and reads stiffly in Korean.

examples.source: Let $r$ be the order of $a$ modulo $N$.
examples.translation: $r$을 $N$에 대한 $a$의 위수로 설정합니다.
examples.suggested: $r$을 $N$을 법으로 한 $a$의 위수라고 합시다.
examples.why: The page defines the term at entry [30] as 'N을 법으로 한 a의 위수'. 'N에 대한' is looser and does not match that definition.

editor_note: None of the 12 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. Alice/Bob outcomes, the A/B swaps, M/N dimensions and the traced-out system in [95] all match the English. The main issue is that "traced out" becomes the italicised term "추적 소거" in [63], [65] and [95]. That reads "trace" as tracking (추적), even though the page renders trace as 대각합 everywhere else; "대각합으로 소거" keeps the concept aligned with 부분 대각합. There are also two smaller slips: [46] uses the uncommon "상첨자" for superscript instead of the standard "위첨자", and [63] drops "in this equation" and uses a clumsy stacked modifier ("$\rho$에 대해 수행되는 $\rho_A$를 얻기 위한 연산").

examples.source: or that $\mathsf{B}$ is *traced out*.
examples.translation: $\mathsf{B}$가 *추적 소거*된다고 말합니다.
examples.suggested: $\mathsf{B}$에 대해 *대각합을 취해 소거한다*(trace out)고 말합니다.
examples.why: 추적 means tracking, not the matrix trace (대각합) used everywhere else on the page, so the term hides the link to 부분 대각합. It is recognisable in context and used the same way in [65] and [95], so this is minor.

examples.source: (A superscript is also sometimes used rather than a subscript.)
examples.translation: (상첨자도 때때로 아래첨자 대신 사용됩니다.)
examples.suggested: (아래첨자 대신 위첨자를 쓰기도 합니다.)
examples.why: 위첨자 is the standard Korean term and pairs naturally with 아래첨자. 상첨자 is rare, and the sentence structure is calqued from English.

examples.source: The operation being performed on $\rho$ to obtain $\rho_{\mathsf{A}}$ in this equation is known as the *partial trace*
examples.translation: $\rho$에 대해 수행되는 $\rho_{\mathsf{A}}$를 얻기 위한 연산은 *부분 대각합*으로 알려지며
examples.suggested: 이 식에서 $\rho_{\mathsf{A}}$를 얻기 위해 $\rho$에 적용하는 연산을 *부분 대각합*이라고 하며
examples.why: The stacked modifiers are stiff translationese, and 'in this equation' is dropped.

editor_note: None of the 8 rewritten entries misleads: the implication order (1⇒2), the gcd divisibility condition, N = nm giving m^2 classical states for W, and the "not necessarily unit vectors" caveat all match the English. Three smaller problems remain. Entry 122 renders "Tracing out a system" as "시스템을 대각합으로 제거하기", which is a clumsy calque that only makes sense because of the "(partial trace)" gloss after it. Entry 16's continuation "이며, …" does not attach cleanly to entry 14, which ends in "생각해 봅시다". Entry 81 uses "고전적 상태" while entries 5, 14 and 39 use "고전 상태".

examples.source: Tracing out a system.
examples.translation: 시스템을 대각합으로 제거하기(partial trace).
examples.suggested: 부분 대각합을 취해 시스템 제거하기.
examples.why: '대각합으로 제거하기' is not how a Korean writer would describe tracing out. Naming the partial trace (부분 대각합) directly matches entry 118 and makes the gloss unnecessary.

examples.source: which, as a density matrix, is given by
examples.translation: 이며, 이를 밀도 행렬로 쓰면 다음과 같습니다.
examples.suggested: 이 상태를 밀도 행렬로 쓰면 다음과 같습니다.
examples.why: Entry 14 ends in the suggestion form '생각해 봅시다' before the displayed state, so a '이며' continuation after the equation doesn't connect grammatically.

examples.source: its classical state set is $\{0,\ldots,N-1\}$ ... $m^2$ classical states
examples.translation: 고전적 상태 집합 ... $m^2$개의 고전적 상태
examples.suggested: 고전 상태 집합 ... $m^2$개의 고전 상태
examples.why: Entries 5, 14 and 39 use '고전 상태'. Mixing it with '고전적 상태' is a minor within-file inconsistency.

editor_note: None of the 34 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. Conditions and quantities match the English, including the N ≤ nm bound (entry 73), the iff faithfulness claim (107) and the X-right/W-left ordering (32), and the terms are right (부분 대각합, 완전 위상 소거, 양의 준정부호). Three small things are worth fixing. Entry 112 adds "단순함을 위해", which is not in the English; that phrase belongs to entry 117. Entry 60 says the input is removed by "대각합", although every other entry on the page uses "부분 대각합" for "traced out". Entry 44 turns "effectively copies" into the calque "효과적으로 복사하고", where "사실상 복사하고" is what the English means.

examples.source: If we assume that $\Sigma = \{0,\ldots, n-1\}$ for some positive integer $n$, then we can alternatively express $J(\Phi)$ as a block matrix:
examples.translation: 단순함을 위해 $\Sigma = \{0,\ldots, n-1\}$인 어떤 양의 정수 $n$이 존재한다고 가정하면, ...
examples.suggested: 어떤 양의 정수 $n$에 대해 $\Sigma = \{0,\ldots, n-1\}$라고 가정하면, $J(\Phi)$를 블록 행렬로도 표현할 수 있습니다.
examples.why: 'For simplicity' is not in the source; it looks copied from entry 117. The added phrase is harmless, but it is still an insertion.

examples.source: ...while the input state $\rho$ gets moved to the bottom qubit and then traced out.
examples.translation: ...입력 상태 $\rho$를 아래쪽 큐비트로 옮긴 후 대각합으로 제거합니다.
examples.suggested: ...입력 상태 $\rho$는 아래쪽 큐비트로 옮겨진 뒤 부분 대각합으로 제거됩니다.
examples.why: Every other entry renders 'traced out' as 부분 대각합. Here it is 대각합, and the sentence also makes the swap gate the one doing the tracing out.

examples.source: the controlled-NOT operation effectively copies the classical state of the input qubit
examples.translation: 제어-NOT 연산이 입력 큐비트의 고전 상태를 효과적으로 복사하고
examples.suggested: 제어-NOT 연산이 입력 큐비트의 고전 상태를 사실상 복사하고
examples.why: 'Effectively' here means 'in effect', not 'efficiently'. 효과적으로 is a calque, and 사실상 says what the English means.

editor_note: None of the six rewritten entries would mislead a learner. Entries 20, 40 and 72 are faithful and natural. Entry 64 has two calques: "양자 컴퓨팅이 … 최적화하는 데 미치는 잠재력" (use "최적화할 수 있는 잠재력") and "전기차를 충전하러 꽂아두고", which a Korean writer would phrase as "전기차를 꽂아 배터리를 충전하고". Entry 50 adds "(V&V)", which is not in the source, and its closing sentence has Boeser giving the "which is why" reason, although in the English that is the author's statement. Entry 55 reads stiffly ("계산하는 데 있어서의 발전을 최근 입증하며") and keeps the English title in "Dr. Vijay Swarup" instead of writing "Vijay Swarup 박사".

examples.source: explore the potential of quantum computing to optimize ... You plug in your electric car to charge the battery
examples.translation: 양자 컴퓨팅이 [...]를 최적화하는 데 미치는 잠재력을 탐색하고 ... 전기차를 충전하러 꽂아두고
examples.suggested: 양자 컴퓨팅이 [...]를 최적화할 수 있는 잠재력을 탐색하고 ... 전기차를 꽂아 배터리를 충전하고
examples.why: '~하는 데 미치는 잠재력' is a calque, and '충전하러 꽂아두고' is awkward. Neither changes the meaning.

examples.source: Boeser notes that "...," which is why Daimler Mercedez-Benz worked with IBM Quantum ... / software verification and validation
examples.translation: Boeser는 "..."고 지적하며, 이것이 Daimler Mercedez-Benz가 ... IBM Quantum과 협력한 이유라고 설명합니다 / 소프트웨어 검증 및 확인(V&V)
examples.suggested: Boeser는 "..."고 지적합니다. 이것이 Daimler Mercedez-Benz가 ... IBM Quantum과 협력한 이유입니다 / 소프트웨어 검증 및 확인
examples.why: In the English the 'which is why' reason is the author's, but the Korean has Boeser giving it. '(V&V)' was also added. Both are small changes that do not mislead.

examples.source: says Dr. Vijay Swarup ... demonstrated advancements in using quantum computers to accurately calculate thermodynamic observables
examples.translation: Dr. Vijay Swarup은 ... 열역학적 관측량을 정확하게 계산하는 데 있어서의 발전을 최근 입증하며
examples.suggested: Vijay Swarup 박사는 ... 양자 컴퓨터로 열역학적 관측량을 정확하게 계산하는 기술을 발전시켰음을 최근 입증하며
examples.why: '~데 있어서의 발전' is stiff translationese, and a Korean text would write '박사' instead of the English title 'Dr.'.

editor_note: None of the five rewritten entries (6, 22, 32, 50, 59) would mislead a learner. Negations, quantities and caveats all hold: the 8th iteration versus 10 iterations, "a bit different due to noise, still better than ideal DCQO", and "one of the first times" over 100 qubits. The remaining problems are polish. Entries 6 and 32 switch speech levels inside one paragraph: "감을 잡아 볼게요" and "인식하고 있어요" sit among 합니다-form sentences. Entry 22 has a calqued "우리는 휴리스틱 솔루션이라는 개념을 도입합니다" and drops the "know and love" nuance. Entry 50 turns "in hopes of discovering new physics" into a flatly stated "궁극적인 목표", which slightly strengthens the claim.

examples.source: Within these broad application areas, the community sees the benefit in groups working together ... IBM spearheaded an initiative ...
examples.translation: ...협력하는 것의 이점을 인식하고 있어요. IBM®은 ... 이니셔티브를 주도했습니다.
examples.suggested: ...협력하는 것의 이점을 인식하고 있습니다. (use one speech level throughout the paragraph; the same applies to '감을 잡아 볼게요' in entry 6)
examples.why: The speech level changes between two sentences of the same paragraph, which reads as patched rather than written in one voice.

examples.source: We introduce the idea of heuristic solutions. If you're an experimentalist you likely know and love these types of solutions.
examples.translation: 우리는 휴리스틱 솔루션이라는 개념을 도입합니다. 실험주의자라면 이러한 유형의 솔루션을 잘 알고 있을 것입니다.
examples.suggested: 여기서 휴리스틱 해법이라는 개념이 등장합니다. 실험 연구자라면 이런 해법에 익숙하고 또 애용하고 있을 거예요.
examples.why: '우리는 ...을 도입합니다' is a literal calque of 'We introduce'. '실험주의자' is an unusual word choice, and dropping 'love' loses the friendly tone of the original.

examples.source: The aim is to solve difficult theoretical problems more precisely and use experiments to accept or reject theories in hopes of discovering new physics, building improved detectors...
examples.translation: 궁극적인 목표는 ... 실험을 통해 이론을 수용하거나 기각함으로써 새로운 물리학을 발견하고, 더 개선된 검출기를 개발하며...
examples.suggested: 목표는 어려운 이론적 문제를 더 정밀하게 풀고 실험으로 이론을 검증(채택 또는 기각)하는 것이며, 이를 통해 새로운 물리학을 발견하고 더 나은 검출기를 만들 수 있기를 기대합니다.
examples.why: The source presents discovering new physics as a hope ('in hopes of'). The translation makes it part of a stated 'ultimate aim', which slightly strengthens the claim. This does not mislead but should be adjusted.

editor_note: None of the five rewritten entries (1, 65, 99, 119, 152) misleads a learner. The scaling claims in [119] (O(N^2), O(N), r ~ log N, O(N^2 log N)) are all kept correctly, and so are the caveats in [99] and [152]. The problems are wording. In [119], the closing phrase "이것이 핵심적으로 염두에 둘 증가 기준입니다" is stiff and vague: "증가 기준" is not a natural way to say "scaling", and "dominant" has been weakened to "핵심적으로". In [152], "later lessons" is rendered as "이후 레슨", but the rest of the page says 강의 or 단원, and it writes "트로터(Trotter) 단계" where nearby entries have "Trotter 단계".

examples.source: Although there are other steps, like orthogonalization, this is the dominant scaling to keep in mind.
examples.translation: 직교화와 같은 다른 단계도 있지만, 이것이 핵심적으로 염두에 둘 증가 기준입니다.
examples.suggested: 직교화와 같은 다른 단계도 있지만, 염두에 두어야 할 지배적인 스케일링은 바로 이것입니다.
examples.why: '증가 기준' is an odd calque for 'scaling', and '핵심적으로' loses the meaning of 'dominant' (the leading cost term). The page already uses 스케일링 elsewhere, e.g. [84], [98], [223].

examples.source: We will explore methods in later lessons that allow us to scale and project our Hamiltonians onto larger subspaces.
examples.translation: 이후 레슨에서는 해밀토니안을 더 큰 부분공간으로 확장하고 투영할 수 있는 방법을 살펴볼 것입니다.
examples.suggested: 이후 강의에서는 해밀토니안을 더 큰 부분공간으로 확장하고 투영할 수 있는 방법을 살펴볼 것입니다.
examples.why: Everywhere else the page says 강의 for 'lesson' ([4], [45], [227]) or 단원 ([69]). The loanword '레슨' breaks that consistency.

examples.source: We specify the number of Trotter steps to use in the time evolution.
examples.translation: 시간 진화에 사용할 트로터(Trotter) 단계 수를 지정하고, ...
examples.suggested: 시간 진화에 사용할 Trotter 단계 수를 지정하고, ...
examples.why: Nearby entries write 'Trotter 단계' and 'Trotter 분해' ([186], [187], [225]). The Hangul-with-gloss form here adds a third variant alongside '트로터화'.

editor_note: None of the five rewritten entries (27, 48, 68, 77, 80) would mislead a learner. Entry 27 keeps the measurement caveat, the "not a sufficient condition" claim and the kernel-trick nuance, and entry 80 keeps the 14th/19th data-point example, the 0.821 output and the kernel-matrix explanation. The problems are style only. The register is split: entry 48 uses 해요체 ("풀 수 있어요"), which is the house style, while entries 27 and 80 use formal 합니다체. Entry 27's "한 가지 이유는 … 포함하며 우리는 … 할 수는 없습니다" never closes the "이유는" subject, "산출할 것입니다" is translationese, and entry 80's "이진 분류(그 외에도)의 일환으로" is a stiff calque.

examples.line_approx: For one thing, any application ... will involve measurements and we cannot measure a qubit to be in multiple states at once.
examples.source: For one thing, any application of quantum computing to machine learning will involve measurements and we cannot measure a qubit to be in multiple states at once.
examples.translation: 한 가지 이유는 머신 러닝에 대한 양자 컴퓨팅의 모든 응용은 측정을 포함하며 우리는 Qubit을 측정했을 때 여러 상태가 동시에 결과로 나오게 할 수는 없습니다.
examples.suggested: 우선, 머신 러닝에 양자 컴퓨팅을 응용하려면 반드시 측정을 거쳐야 하는데, 큐비트를 측정해서 여러 상태를 동시에 얻을 수는 없어요.
examples.why: The sentence opens with the subject '이유는' and never finishes it with '~때문이에요'. That is a calqued structure a native writer would rewrite. The meaning is still correct.

examples.line_approx: Many processes in machine learning use inner products as part of binary classification (among other things).
examples.source: Many processes in machine learning use inner products as part of binary classification (among other things).
examples.translation: 머신 러닝의 많은 프로세스는 이진 분류(그 외에도)의 일환으로 내적을 사용합니다.
examples.suggested: 머신 러닝의 많은 프로세스는 이진 분류 등에서 내적을 사용해요.
examples.why: The parenthetical '(그 외에도)' is a literal calque. The entry also uses 합니다체, while the rewritten entry 48 uses the house 해요체, so the register is inconsistent across the delta. This is a minor register slip.

examples.line_approx: True or False? Highly entangled quantum states enable us...
examples.source: True or False? Highly entangled quantum states enable us to solve most machine learning problems more efficiently on a quantum computer.
examples.translation: 참 또는 거짓? 고도로 얽힌 양자 상태를 이용하면 양자 컴퓨터에서 대부분의 머신 러닝 문제를 더 효율적으로 풀 수 있어요.
examples.suggested: 참일까요, 거짓일까요? 고도로 얽힌 양자 상태를 이용하면 양자 컴퓨터에서 대부분의 머신 러닝 문제를 더 효율적으로 풀 수 있어요.
examples.why: The meaning is faithful and the 해요체 is correct. '참 또는 거짓?' is a literal rendering of the English label, and it sits next to 합니다체 text in entries 27 and 80, so the page's register is mixed.

editor_note: None of the 20 rewritten entries changes the meaning of the English. Conditions, caveats and quantities all survive: the noise caveat in [172], the "±ħ/2" reiteration in [127], the 50-50 and zero-probability claims in [156]/[158], and the "only one axis (z)" claim in [148]. The problems are all minor. [98] carries a stiff calque, "(스핀 업 상태와 스핀 다운 상태의 유사한 수와 같이)". In [148], "vice-versa" became "그 반대 방향으로도 변환", which can be misread as "to the opposite direction" instead of "z back to x". [92] names the module series "Qiskit 교실 모듈" and writes "Bell의 정리", but [69] has "Qiskit Classrooms 모듈" and "벨 정리". [148] also says "화면" where the rest of the page says "스크린".

examples.source: yield similar numbers of 0 and 1 states (like similar numbers of spin up and spin down states)
examples.translation: 유사한 수의 0 상태와 1 상태(스핀 업 상태와 스핀 다운 상태의 유사한 수와 같이)를 생성한다는 것을
examples.suggested: 0 상태와 1 상태가 비슷한 수로 나온다는 것을(스핀 업과 스핀 다운이 비슷한 수로 나오는 것처럼)
examples.why: The parenthetical copies English word order and "yield" became 생성하다. A Korean writer would say "비슷한 수로 나온다".

examples.source: takes states along $x$ in the Bloch sphere to $z$, and vice-versa
examples.translation: $x$ 방향의 상태를 $z$ 방향으로, 그 반대 방향으로도 변환하는 연산
examples.suggested: $x$ 방향의 상태를 $z$ 방향으로, 반대로 $z$ 방향의 상태를 $x$ 방향으로 변환하는 연산
examples.why: "그 반대 방향으로도" can be read as "into the opposite direction" rather than the reverse mapping z→x. Spelling out the reverse removes the ambiguity.

examples.source: See the Qiskit Classroom module on Bell's theorem
examples.translation: Bell의 정리에 관한 Qiskit 교실 모듈을 참조하세요
examples.suggested: 벨 정리를 다루는 Qiskit Classrooms 모듈을 참고하세요
examples.why: Entry [69] names the same module "Qiskit Classrooms 모듈" and writes "벨 정리". This entry translates the series name and switches to "Bell의 정리".

examples.source: look for deflections along $x$ on the screen
examples.translation: 화면에서 $x$ 방향의 편향을 관찰하면 됩니다
examples.suggested: 스크린에서 $x$ 방향의 편향을 관찰하면 됩니다
examples.why: The detector screen is "스크린" everywhere else on the page ([30], [48], [54]). "화면" suggests a display monitor.

editor_note: None of the three rewritten entries (15, 65, 94) would mislead a learner. The numbers (35~55%, 26-Qubit tfim), the runtime split and the SABRE-vs-AI caveat all match the English. Two small editorial slips remain. In entry 94, "which happens to be a case where…" became a plain "이 경우", which drops the sense of chance that sets up the next sentence's "not representative" caveat. In entry 65, "the most frequent winner" became "가장 자주 승리하고", which reads like sports-commentary calque in a benchmarking context. Entry 15 is faithful and natural ("근미래(near-term) 양자 디바이스").

examples.source: which happens to be a case where SABRE produces a much higher two-qubit depth
examples.translation: 이 경우 SABRE가 AI 기반 Transpiler와 Rustiq보다 훨씬 높은 2-Qubit 깊이를 생성하므로
examples.suggested: 공교롭게도 SABRE가 AI 기반 Transpiler와 Rustiq보다 훨씬 높은 2-Qubit 깊이를 생성하는 경우여서
examples.why: The translation drops the qualifier 'happens to', which marks this circuit as a chance outlier. The caveat that follows still stands, so this is a dropped qualifier, not a false claim.

examples.source: it is the most frequent winner on two-qubit depth
examples.translation: 2-Qubit 깊이에서 가장 자주 승리하고
examples.suggested: 2-Qubit 깊이에서 최고 결과를 낸 비율이 가장 높고
examples.why: '승리' is a literal calque of 'winner'. A Korean technical writer would describe how often a method achieved the best value.

editor_note: None of the 8 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. Entry 23 keeps the noise caveat and the upper-bound claim, and entries 120, 121 and 161 carry the right numbers and conditions. The problems are small. Entry 147 uses "당신을 제한하고", which is unnatural in Korean technical prose, and it renders "a minority of the pool" as "일부만", which is slightly weaker. Entry 126's "종마다 네 개의 오비탈과 각각 20개의 자기 부분상태" can be read as 20 substates per orbital, and its "4,000개로 — ..." dash placement is awkward. "time-reversed" is 시간 반전된 in entry 64 but 시간 역전된 in entries 161, 167 and 168.

examples.source: Knowing which of the three is limiting you ... the gate budget covers a minority of the pool
examples.translation: 세 가지 중 어느 것이 당신을 제한하고 있는지를 아는 것이 ... 게이트 예산이 풀의 일부만을 포함하고
examples.suggested: 세 가지 중 무엇이 병목인지 파악하는 것이 ... 게이트 예산이 풀의 절반에도 못 미치는 일부만 포함하고
examples.why: Korean technical writing does not address the reader as 당신. 일부만 also loses the 'minority' (less than half) nuance.

examples.source: has four orbitals per species and 20 magnetic substates each, so the register is 40 qubits ... 4,000 symmetry-allowed determinants — about six times
examples.translation: 종마다 네 개의 오비탈과 각각 20개의 자기 부분상태를 가지므로 ... 행렬식은 4,000개로 — $^{20}\mathrm{Ne}$ 기저의 약 6배이며
examples.suggested: 종마다 오비탈 네 개, 자기 부분상태 20개를 가지므로 ... 행렬식은 4,000개로, $^{20}\mathrm{Ne}$ 기저의 약 6배이며
examples.why: 각각 can attach to the orbitals and suggest 20 substates per orbital. The dash placed after 로 reads awkwardly.

examples.source: time-reversed $(+m_j, -m_j)$ pairs ... the $J = 0$ pairing force
examples.translation: 시간 반전된 $(+m_j, -m_j)$ 쌍 ... $J = 0$ 페어링 힘
examples.suggested: 시간 역전된 $(+m_j, -m_j)$ 쌍 ... $J = 0$ 쌍 상호작용(pairing) 힘
examples.why: Entries 161, 167 and 168 use 시간 역전된, and entry 167 renders pairing as 쌍 상호작용, so this entry is inconsistent with the rest of the file.

editor_note: None of the 11 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The numbers, caveats and claims all match the English: the 20 triangles give 41 qubits, the 4096 shots and the "default bond dimension is sufficient" claim are intact, and the "estimate only" note is kept. There are three minor issues. Entry 50 renders "Qiskit Function" as "Qiskit 함수", but entries 7 and 21 keep "Qiskit Function", which is the house-style form. Entry 17 renders "correlators" as "상관관계" (correlation) where "상관 함수" is the precise term. The register is also mixed: entry 4 ends in 해요체 ("다를 수 있어요"), while entries 7, 16, 17, 33, 40, 47, 50 and 51 all use 합니다체, not the 해요체 convention.

examples.source: Fire Opal provides a Qiskit Function that extends the standard IBM Quantum Estimator primitive
examples.translation: Fire Opal은 ... 표준 IBM Quantum Estimator 프리미티브를 확장하는 Qiskit 함수를 제공합니다.
examples.suggested: Fire Opal은 ... 표준 IBM Quantum Estimator 프리미티브를 확장하는 Qiskit Function을 제공해요.
examples.why: House style keeps the Qiskit Functions name in English. Entries 7 and 21 already write 'Qiskit Function', so '함수' here is both off-style and inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: spin observables like $\langle Z_i \rangle$ and correlators $\langle Z_i Z_j \rangle$
examples.translation: $\langle Z_i \rangle$ 및 상관관계 $\langle Z_i Z_j \rangle$와 같은 스핀 관측량
examples.suggested: $\langle Z_i \rangle$ 및 상관 함수 $\langle Z_i Z_j \rangle$와 같은 스핀 관측량
examples.why: A 'correlator' is a correlation function (an expectation value), not a general 'relationship'. '상관 함수' is the conventional term, and '상관관계' reads loosely.

examples.source: (NOTE: This is an estimate only. Your runtime may vary.)
examples.translation: (참고: 이는 추정치이며, 실제 실행 시간은 다를 수 있어요.)
examples.suggested: Use one register across the page. By convention that is 해요체, e.g. entry 7 '... 도구를 사용해요' and not '사용합니다'.
examples.why: Entry 4 uses 해요체, but the other rewritten entries (7, 16, 17, 33, 40, 47, 50, 51) all end in 합니다체. The page is internally inconsistent and does not follow the 해요체 convention.

editor_note: Rewritten entry 105 is faithful and reads naturally: Sampler's output is correctly given as "shot별 측정 결과를 집계한 counts", and Estimator computes "관측량(observable)의 기댓값" and returns "기댓값과 표준 오차", both matching the English.
